description_en: Retrieves a list of feature consistency check task configurations
description_zh: 获取特征一致性检查任务配置列表
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice list-feature-consistency-check-job-configs --instance-id pairec-cn-00000000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by GmtCreateTime --order ASC --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListFeatureConsistencyCheckJobConfigs

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. To obtain an instance ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2411819.html
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value starts at 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码。起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The field to sort by.

- `GmtCreateTime`: Creation time.

- `GmtModifiedTime`: Modified time
parameters.help_zh:
排序依据。
- GmtCreateTime：按创建时间排序。
- GmtModifiedTime：按更新时间排序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order.

- `ASC`: Ascending order.

- `DESC`: Descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。
- ASC：升序。
- DESC：降序
parameters.name: order
